FULLY RENOVATED STUDIO APARTMENT | AVAILABLE 10/01/2026 🏡✨
Brand new, fully renovated studio with ultra-modern finishes, ideally located steps from Chelsea's Silver Line.
Lease Details & Requirements: • Rent: $1,700/month • Security Deposit: $1,700 • 1st Month Rent: $1,700 • Last Month Rent: $1,700 • No Broker Fee • No Commission • Proof of income required • Credit and background screening • No Pets • Smoke-free building
Utilities: • Hot water included
Tenant Responsible For: • Electricity • Heat
Appliances Included: • Refrigerator • Freezer • Microwave • Stove/Oven • Stainless steel appliances
Key Features: • Studio | 1 full bathroom • Vinyl flooring throughout • Granite countertops • Custom cabinetry • Custom closets • Central A/C • Oversized tile showers • Tall ceilings • Professionally managed building
Additional Features: • Natural lighting • City views • Street parking • Eligible for City parking program
Location Highlights: • Steps from Bellingham Square Station (Silver Line SL3), just blocks from Arlington Street, with direct access to Boston's Financial District, Waterfront, and Seaport • Minutes to Chelsea commuter rail station and Box District Station • Quick access to Downtown Boston, Logan International Airport, and the Medical District • Close to Bunker Hill Community College, Salem State University, and North Shore Community College • Walk to supermarkets, convenience stores, and everyday shopping and dining • Highly walkable, commuter-friendly neighborhood with excellent MBTA bus access
Contact us for more information or to schedule a viewing 📞
